description.en: Links this remote to a Pegasis Hub (a Docker container that runs integrations) over one fast connection. Every integration on the hub appears here under Integrations, as if it were installed on the remote.

label.en: Hub address (host or host:port, shown on the hub's page)
Pairing code (shown on the hub's page)
Web-configurator PIN (used once to create an API key, not stored)
Remove integrations from this remote when they are removed on the hub
